Seedance-prompt-en 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the skill for writing effective prompts for Jimeng Seedance 2.0 multimodal AI video generation.
- Provides a structured guide covering prompt construction, input constraints, output features, and the use of the @ reference system for assets.
- Includes detailed syntax for referencing images, videos, and audio within prompts, as well as recommended prompt blueprints and time-segmented writing.
- Supplies camera terminology and shot type language for crafting precise video instructions.
- Offers templates and examples for common creative needs like character consistency, camera movement replication, effect replication, video extension, and editing.
- Establishes best practices and platform compliance notes for user content creation.
